Subject: Weekly numbers sentinel & 15m call plan — Q4 submission

Team / Priya —

Quick reminder: our weekly forecast submission window opens today at 10:00 PT. I want to run a tight 15‑minute sync at 9:45 PT to surface last‑minute stage moves and any evidence gaps before turn‑in. Goals: close obvious gaps, confirm commit lanes, and upload the final deck.

Agenda (9:45–10:00 PT) — please keep answers brief:
- Status quickfire: any account with stage change since EOD yesterday? (name + new stage + confidence %)
- Evidence checklist: decks, POs, SOC 2 excerpts (who will upload)
- Any required pricing or credit approvals to route today
- Final owner for Acme Retail row (see notes)

Attachments: Forecast_Template_Q4.xlsx (master), Acme_account_updates.pdf — please pull the template and paste your rows in the "Submission" tab.

Action items before 9:30 PT:
- Marissa: confirm the 3 late‑stage opportunities (account names in follow up)
- Sofia: upload support evidence for SOC 2 + retention policy by 9:30
- Priya: confirm that the PO email will land today (even a statement of intent is fine)

Call invite is in calendar (15 minutes). If you cannot attend, drop a one‑line update in the thread with the account rows merged into the template and mark owner.

Thanks —
Rachel Kim
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Forecast_Template_Q4.xlsx (xlsx)
Attachment: Acme_account_updates.pdf (pdf)
